issues.description: Visibility mismatch for accessor methods declared in the solution: the exercise (problem statement) requires implementing getters for every Lecture attribute and the named tests (e.g., getLectureNameTest, getNumberOfInscribedStudentsTest) imply these getters must be publicly accessible. In the solution implementation, two accessor methods are declared private: "private String getLectureName()" and "private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()". Making these getters private prevents external code or tests from calling them and contradicts the exercise instructions, which will confuse students and break test access.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of the two accessor methods in the solution (and ensure the template's expected signatures match) from private to public so they match the exercise requirements. Concretely, declare: public String getLectureName() { ... } and public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents() { ... }. Verify all getters in Lecture are public and have the return types specified by the UML and problem statement so external code and tests can access them.
